sloka: दीयताम् निखिलेनैव सत्यस्त्वम् भव पार्थिव ।अहम् निदेशम् भवतो यथोक्तमनुपालयन् ॥२-३४-४३॥
transliteration: dīyatām nikhilenaiva satyastvam bhava pārthiva ।aham nideśam bhavato yathoktamanupālayan ॥2-34-43॥

translations.english: As already said, I shall dwell in the forest for fourteen years with forest rangers, in obedience to your commands.
